# Everything (voidtools)

`Everything.exe`, `Everything.lng` and `Everything64.dll` (the Everything SDK)
are from [Everything](https://www.voidtools.com/) by voidtools, copied from the
FileManagement project that WorkSync's Catalog comes from.

They ship with the Windows build only (see `forge.config.mts`). WorkSync uses
an Everything that is already installed first, and this copy otherwise. See
voidtools' site for Everything's licence.
